svg.title: Planned Mandelbrot render farm architecture
svg.desc: Each of three coordinators contains a persistent Raft log and its own replica of the durable task queue. The scheduler reads pending tasks from its local queue. Raft replicates commands, and each coordinator applies committed commands to its queue. Workers communicate with the leader. Accepted grids are read from the durable queue for image assembly.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 36, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
